description: SessionStart adds one line of context (also after /clear or compaction) so Claude loads the skill for every coding task; agents often skip skills for short requests. The hooks module (register.tsx) adds the checklist tool and draws it above the input, switchable in /config; Claude Code versions without hooks modules ignore it.

hooks.command: echo 'For every coding task (writing, fixing, debugging, refactoring, reviewing or testing code, even a small fix), load the agent-skill-ultimate-coding:agent-skill-ultimate-coding skill first and follow it. Any task that adds or changes logic starts with its checklist, before any code: in the checklist tool when you have it, otherwise in your task list.'
